source: Arterial blood pressure is regulated on a short time scale by the baroreceptor reflex. A sudden fall in pressure reduces baroreceptor firing, which increases sympathetic activity and decreases parasympathetic activity. The resulting rise in heart rate, cardiac contractility, and vascular resistance helps restore blood pressure.
title: Baroreflex
zh: 動脈血壓可透過壓力感受器反射在短時間內受到調節。血壓突然下降時，壓力感受器的放電頻率降低，使交感神經活性增加、副交感神經活性減少。隨之升高的心率、心肌收縮力及血管阻力，有助於恢復血壓。

source: The kidneys maintain a relatively stable glomerular filtration rate over a range of arterial pressures. Myogenic responses of the afferent arteriole and tubuloglomerular feedback both contribute to this autoregulation, allowing filtration to remain stable despite moderate changes in systemic blood pressure.
title: Renal autoregulation
zh: 腎臟能在一定的動脈壓範圍內，維持相對穩定的腎絲球過濾率。入球小動脈的肌源性反應與管球回饋都參與這種自我調節，因此即使全身血壓出現中等程度的變化，過濾功能仍能維持穩定。

source: Cytosolic calcium concentration is kept low under resting conditions. Brief increases in intracellular calcium can act as signals that regulate contraction, secretion, metabolism, and gene expression. Calcium is removed from the cytosol by pumps and exchangers or sequestered into intracellular organelles.
title: Calcium signaling
zh: 靜止狀態下，細胞質中的鈣離子濃度維持在低水平。細胞內鈣離子濃度短暫升高時，可作為訊號，調控收縮、分泌、代謝與基因表現。鈣離子會透過幫浦及交換器移出細胞質，或被儲存到細胞內胞器中。

source: The lungs and kidneys cooperate to maintain acid-base homeostasis. Ventilation can alter carbon dioxide levels within minutes, whereas the kidneys adjust bicarbonate reabsorption and hydrogen ion excretion over a longer time scale. Disturbance in either system can change blood pH.
title: Acid-base balance
zh: 肺臟與腎臟共同維持酸鹼恆定。通氣作用能在數分鐘內改變二氧化碳濃度；相較之下，腎臟需要較長時間，藉由調整碳酸氫根的再吸收與氫離子的排泄來調節。任一系統發生異常，都可能改變血液的酸鹼值。

source: Many endocrine systems are controlled by negative feedback. When the concentration of a hormone or its physiological effect rises, signals are generated that reduce further hormone secretion. This organization stabilizes the internal environment while allowing the system to respond to changing demands.
title: Endocrine feedback
zh: 許多內分泌系統受到負回饋控制。當荷爾蒙濃度上升或其生理效應增強時，系統會產生訊號，減少後續的荷爾蒙分泌。這種安排能穩定內在環境，同時使系統因應不斷改變的需求。

source: Voltage-gated ion channels produce the rapid changes in membrane potential that characterize an action potential. Sodium entry drives the membrane toward positive potentials, whereas potassium efflux contributes to repolarization. Channel inactivation also creates a refractory period that limits firing frequency.
title: Action potential
zh: 電壓閘控離子通道造成膜電位快速變化，形成動作電位的特徵。鈉離子流入使膜電位朝正值移動，鉀離子流出則有助於再極化。通道的失活也會形成不反應期，限制放電頻率。

source: Pacemaker cells in the sinoatrial node do not have a stable resting membrane potential. Slow inward currents gradually depolarize the membrane until threshold is reached, after which calcium-dependent channels contribute to the action potential. Autonomic input changes the slope of this spontaneous depolarization and therefore changes heart rate.
title: Cardiac pacemaker
zh: 竇房結的節律細胞沒有穩定的靜止膜電位。緩慢的內向電流使細胞膜逐漸去極化，直到達到閾值，之後鈣依賴性通道參與動作電位的形成。自主神經輸入會改變這段自發去極化的斜率，因而改變心率。

source: Renin secretion from juxtaglomerular cells increases when renal perfusion pressure falls, when sympathetic activity rises, or when sodium chloride delivery to the macula densa decreases. Renin initiates the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system, which helps restore arterial pressure and extracellular fluid volume.
title: Renin release
zh: 當腎灌流壓下降、交感神經活性增加，或到達緻密斑的氯化鈉減少時，腎絲球旁細胞的腎素分泌會增加。腎素會啟動腎素－血管張力素－醛固酮系統，幫助恢復動脈壓及細胞外液量。

source: Antidiuretic hormone increases water reabsorption in the collecting duct by promoting insertion of aquaporin-2 channels into the apical membrane of principal cells. This response allows the kidney to produce a more concentrated urine when plasma osmolality rises or effective circulating volume falls.
title: ADH and water balance
zh: 抗利尿激素會促進水通道蛋白二型插入集合管主細胞的頂端膜，增加集合管對水的再吸收。當血漿滲透壓濃度上升或有效循環血量下降時，這項反應使腎臟能產生更濃縮的尿液。

source: Pulmonary surfactant lowers surface tension at the air-liquid interface of the alveoli. By doing so, it reduces the tendency of small alveoli to collapse and increases lung compliance. A deficiency of surfactant can greatly increase the work required for breathing.
title: Pulmonary surfactant
zh: 肺表面活性劑能降低肺泡氣液介面的表面張力，減少小肺泡塌陷的傾向，並提高肺順應性。缺乏表面活性劑時，呼吸所需做的功可能大幅增加。

source: Hemoglobin releases oxygen more readily when carbon dioxide, hydrogen ion concentration, temperature, or 2,3-bisphosphoglycerate increases. This rightward shift of the oxygen dissociation curve facilitates oxygen delivery to metabolically active tissues.
title: Oxygen dissociation
zh: 當二氧化碳、氫離子濃度、溫度或二、三－二磷酸甘油酸增加時，血紅素會更容易釋放氧氣。氧解離曲線因此右移，有利於將氧氣供應給代謝活躍的組織。

source: When an action potential reaches a presynaptic terminal, voltage-gated calcium channels open. The resulting calcium influx triggers synaptic vesicles to fuse with the membrane and release neurotransmitter. The transmitter then binds receptors on the postsynaptic cell and changes its electrical or biochemical state.
title: Synaptic release
zh: 當動作電位到達突觸前末端時，電壓閘控鈣離子通道會開啟。隨後流入的鈣離子促使突觸囊泡與細胞膜融合，釋放神經傳遞物質。傳遞物質再與突觸後細胞的受體結合，改變其電性或生化狀態。

source: In skeletal muscle, an action potential travels along the sarcolemma and into the transverse tubules. This electrical signal triggers calcium release from the sarcoplasmic reticulum. Calcium binds troponin, allowing actin and myosin to interact and generate force.
title: Skeletal muscle
zh: 在骨骼肌中，動作電位沿著肌細胞膜傳遞，並進入橫小管。這個電訊號促使肌漿網釋放鈣離子。鈣離子與肌鈣蛋白結合，使肌動蛋白與肌凝蛋白能夠互動並產生力量。

source: Insulin promotes glucose uptake in skeletal muscle and adipose tissue and favors the storage of nutrients as glycogen and lipid. In the liver, insulin suppresses pathways that produce glucose. These coordinated actions lower blood glucose after a meal.
title: Insulin action
zh: 胰島素促進骨骼肌與脂肪組織攝取葡萄糖，並促使營養物以肝醣與脂質的形式儲存。在肝臟中，胰島素會抑制產生葡萄糖的代謝途徑。這些協調作用能降低餐後血糖。

source: The hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis is controlled by negative feedback. Corticotropin-releasing hormone stimulates ACTH secretion, which in turn promotes cortisol production by the adrenal cortex. Rising cortisol suppresses further CRH and ACTH release.
title: Cortisol feedback
zh: 下視丘－腦下垂體－腎上腺軸受到負回饋控制。促腎上腺皮質激素釋放激素會刺激促腎上腺皮質激素分泌，後者再促進腎上腺皮質製造皮質醇。皮質醇濃度上升時，會抑制前述兩種激素進一步釋放。

source: An increase in extracellular potassium reduces the concentration gradient that normally drives potassium out of cells. Because resting membranes are often highly permeable to potassium, the resting membrane potential becomes less negative. Severe hyperkalemia can therefore alter excitability and cardiac conduction.
title: Extracellular potassium
zh: 細胞外鉀離子濃度增加，會減小原本驅使鉀離子離開細胞的濃度梯度。由於靜止時的細胞膜通常對鉀離子具有較高通透性，靜止膜電位會變得較不負。因此，嚴重高血鉀可能改變細胞興奮性及心臟傳導。

source: In metabolic acidosis, the primary disturbance is a fall in bicarbonate concentration. The respiratory system can compensate within minutes by increasing ventilation and lowering carbon dioxide. The kidneys provide slower compensation by increasing net acid excretion and regenerating bicarbonate.
title: Metabolic acidosis
zh: 代謝性酸中毒的主要異常是碳酸氫根濃度下降。呼吸系統能在數分鐘內增加通氣、降低二氧化碳濃度，產生代償。腎臟則透過增加淨酸排泄及再生碳酸氫根，提供較慢的代償。

source: Glomerular filtration depends on the balance of hydrostatic and oncotic pressures across the filtration barrier. High pressure in glomerular capillaries favors filtration, whereas pressure in Bowman space and plasma oncotic pressure oppose it. Changes in arteriolar resistance can therefore alter glomerular filtration rate.
title: Glomerular filtration
zh: 腎絲球過濾取決於過濾屏障兩側靜水壓與膠體滲透壓的平衡。腎絲球微血管內的高壓有利於過濾，鮑氏囊腔內壓力及血漿膠體滲透壓則抵抗過濾。因此，小動脈阻力改變也能改變腎絲球過濾率。

source: The loop of Henle contributes to a hyperosmotic renal medulla through countercurrent multiplication. Differences in water and solute permeability between the descending and ascending limbs create a longitudinal osmotic gradient. This gradient allows collecting ducts to reabsorb water efficiently in the presence of antidiuretic hormone.
title: Countercurrent mechanism
zh: 亨利氏環透過逆流倍增作用，協助腎髓質建立高滲透壓環境。降支與升支對水及溶質的通透性不同，因而形成沿腎髓質縱向分布的滲透梯度。有抗利尿激素存在時，集合管可利用這個梯度有效再吸收水分。

source: Central chemoreceptors respond mainly to changes in carbon dioxide through changes in hydrogen ion concentration in the cerebrospinal fluid. Peripheral chemoreceptors can respond to low arterial oxygen as well as carbon dioxide and pH. Together they adjust ventilation to maintain blood-gas homeostasis.
title: Chemoreceptors
zh: 中樞化學感受器主要透過腦脊髓液中氫離子濃度的變化，感受二氧化碳的改變。周邊化學感受器除了能對二氧化碳與酸鹼值反應，也能感受動脈低氧。兩者共同調節通氣，以維持血液氣體的恆定。

source: Mean arterial pressure is determined largely by cardiac output and total peripheral resistance. Short-term regulation depends heavily on neural reflexes, while long-term regulation requires control of extracellular fluid volume by the kidneys and hormones.
title: Mean arterial pressure
zh: 平均動脈壓主要由心輸出量與總周邊阻力決定。短期調節高度依賴神經反射，長期調節則需要腎臟與荷爾蒙控制細胞外液量。

source: The concentration of free calcium in the cytosol is much lower than that outside the cell or inside intracellular stores. Pumps, exchangers, and calcium-binding proteins maintain this gradient. Transient changes in cytosolic calcium can therefore serve as rapid intracellular signals.
title: Calcium homeostasis
zh: 細胞質中的游離鈣離子濃度，遠低於細胞外及細胞內儲存區的濃度。幫浦、交換器與鈣結合蛋白共同維持這個梯度。因此，細胞質鈣離子濃度的短暫變化能作為快速的細胞內訊號。

source: Peptide hormones usually act through receptors on the cell surface because they do not readily cross the plasma membrane. Steroid hormones can cross the membrane and bind intracellular receptors that regulate gene transcription. The two strategies produce different time courses and patterns of cellular response.
title: Endocrine receptors
zh: 胜肽類荷爾蒙不易穿越細胞膜，因此通常透過細胞表面的受體發揮作用。類固醇荷爾蒙則能穿過細胞膜，與細胞內受體結合並調控基因轉錄。這兩種方式會產生不同的反應時間及細胞反應模式。

source: A homeostatic control system typically includes a regulated variable, a sensor, an integrating center, and one or more effectors. Negative feedback reduces deviations from a target range, whereas positive feedback amplifies a process until a terminating event occurs.
title: Homeostatic control
zh: 恆定控制系統通常包含受調節的變數、感受器、整合中心，以及一個或多個效應器。負回饋能縮小變數偏離目標範圍的程度；正回饋則會放大某個過程，直到終止事件發生。

source: Pacemaker cells in the sinoatrial node do not maintain a stable resting membrane potential. Slow inward currents gradually depolarize the membrane until threshold is reached, after which calcium-dependent currents contribute to the action potential. Autonomic input changes the slope of this spontaneous depolarization and therefore alters heart rate.
title: Cardiac pacemaker
zh: 竇房結的節律細胞不會維持穩定的靜止膜電位。緩慢的內向電流使細胞膜逐漸去極化，直到達到閾值，之後鈣依賴性電流參與動作電位的形成。自主神經輸入會改變這段自發去極化的斜率，進而改變心率。

source: Fluid movement across capillary walls depends on hydrostatic and oncotic pressure differences as well as the permeability of the capillary barrier. Changes in these Starling forces can favor filtration or reabsorption. Excess filtration that is not removed by lymphatic drainage can contribute to edema.
title: Capillary exchange
zh: 液體穿越微血管壁的移動，取決於兩側的靜水壓差、膠體滲透壓差，以及微血管屏障的通透性。這些史達林力的改變可能促進過濾或再吸收。若過多的濾出液未被淋巴引流移除，就可能造成水腫。

source: Filtered glucose is normally reabsorbed in the proximal tubule through sodium-glucose cotransporters. When the filtered load exceeds the transport capacity, glucose remains in the tubular fluid and appears in the urine. This can also increase osmotic water loss.
title: Renal glucose handling
zh: 經過濾的葡萄糖，正常會透過鈉－葡萄糖共同運輸蛋白，在近端腎小管被再吸收。當過濾負荷超過運輸能力時，葡萄糖會留在腎小管液中，並出現在尿液裡。這也可能增加滲透性水分流失。

source: The loop of Henle establishes an osmotic gradient in the renal medulla. The ascending limb reabsorbs salt but is relatively impermeable to water, while the descending limb is more permeable to water. This arrangement allows the kidney to produce concentrated urine when antidiuretic hormone is present.
title: Countercurrent mechanism
zh: 亨利氏環會在腎髓質建立滲透梯度。升支再吸收鹽分，但對水相對不通透；降支則對水具有較高通透性。有抗利尿激素存在時，這種安排使腎臟能產生濃縮尿液。

source: Efficient pulmonary gas exchange requires coordination between alveolar ventilation and pulmonary blood flow. Regions with low ventilation relative to perfusion can lower arterial oxygenation, whereas areas with high ventilation but little perfusion behave more like dead space.
title: Ventilation perfusion matching
zh: 有效的肺部氣體交換，需要肺泡通氣與肺血流彼此配合。相對於灌流量，通氣不足的區域會降低動脈血氧合程度；而通氣高、灌流卻很少的區域，其表現則較接近死腔。

source: Hemoglobin releases oxygen more readily in metabolically active tissues where carbon dioxide, hydrogen ion concentration, and temperature are increased. These local changes reduce hemoglobin oxygen affinity and support oxygen delivery to tissues with greater metabolic demand.
title: Oxygen unloading
zh: 在代謝活躍、二氧化碳濃度、氫離子濃度與溫度較高的組織中，血紅素更容易釋放氧氣。這些局部變化會降低血紅素對氧的親和力，幫助將氧氣送達代謝需求較高的組織。

source: Insulin binds to a receptor tyrosine kinase and activates intracellular signaling pathways including PI3K and Akt. In skeletal muscle and adipose tissue, this promotes translocation of GLUT4 transporters to the plasma membrane and increases glucose uptake.
title: Insulin signaling
zh: 胰島素與受體酪胺酸激酶結合後，會啟動包括磷脂醯肌醇三激酶及蛋白激酶乙在內的細胞內訊號途徑。在骨骼肌與脂肪組織中，這會促使第四型葡萄糖運輸蛋白移至細胞膜，增加葡萄糖攝取。

source: Psychological or physiological stress can activate the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis. Corticotropin-releasing hormone stimulates ACTH secretion, which promotes cortisol release from the adrenal cortex. Cortisol then exerts negative feedback on the hypothalamus and pituitary.
title: HPA axis
zh: 心理或生理壓力可啟動下視丘－腦下垂體－腎上腺軸。促腎上腺皮質激素釋放激素刺激促腎上腺皮質激素分泌，進而促使腎上腺皮質釋放皮質醇。之後，皮質醇會對下視丘與腦下垂體產生負回饋。

source: A neuron receives many excitatory and inhibitory synaptic inputs. These postsynaptic potentials can summate across time and space, and the net effect at the axon initial segment determines whether the membrane reaches threshold for an action potential.
title: Synaptic integration
zh: 神經元會接收許多興奮性與抑制性突觸輸入。這些突觸後電位能在時間與空間上加成，而它們在軸突起始段產生的淨效應，決定細胞膜是否達到觸發動作電位的閾值。

source: Myelin increases membrane resistance and reduces capacitance along the axon. As a result, depolarizing current spreads farther between nodes of Ranvier, where voltage-gated sodium channels regenerate the action potential. This saltatory conduction greatly increases conduction velocity.
title: Myelinated conduction
zh: 髓鞘會提高軸突膜的電阻並降低電容。因此，去極化電流可以在郎飛氏結之間傳得更遠，並在郎飛氏結由電壓閘控鈉離子通道重新產生動作電位。這種跳躍式傳導能大幅提高傳導速度。

source: An action potential travels along the muscle membrane and into the transverse tubules, triggering calcium release from the sarcoplasmic reticulum. Calcium binds to troponin, allowing actin and myosin to interact and generate force through repeated cross-bridge cycling.
title: Skeletal muscle contraction
zh: 動作電位沿肌細胞膜傳遞並進入橫小管，促使肌漿網釋放鈣離子。鈣離子與肌鈣蛋白結合，讓肌動蛋白與肌凝蛋白可以互動，並透過反覆的橫橋循環產生力量。

source: Primary respiratory and metabolic acid-base disturbances trigger compensatory responses in other organ systems. The lungs can change carbon dioxide rapidly through ventilation, whereas the kidneys adjust bicarbonate handling and acid excretion more slowly.
title: Acid-base compensation
zh: 原發性的呼吸性與代謝性酸鹼異常，會引發其他器官系統的代償反應。肺臟可透過通氣快速改變二氧化碳濃度，腎臟則較慢地調整碳酸氫根的處理與酸的排泄。

source: Many organs can maintain relatively stable blood flow despite moderate changes in perfusion pressure. Local metabolic signals and myogenic responses alter arteriolar resistance, helping match tissue blood supply to metabolic demand.
title: Autoregulation of blood flow
zh: 許多器官能在灌流壓出現中等程度變化時，維持相對穩定的血流。局部代謝訊號與肌源性反應會改變小動脈阻力，幫助組織的血液供應配合其代謝需求。

source: Antidiuretic hormone acts on V2 receptors in collecting duct principal cells. It increases the insertion of aquaporin-2 water channels into the apical membrane, allowing more water to be reabsorbed when the renal medulla is hyperosmotic.
title: ADH and water balance
zh: 抗利尿激素作用於集合管主細胞的第二型加壓素受體，增加水通道蛋白二型插入頂端膜的數量。在腎髓質呈高滲透壓的情況下，這會使更多水分被再吸收。

source: Aldosterone increases sodium reabsorption and potassium secretion in the distal nephron. It promotes the expression and activity of epithelial sodium channels and the sodium-potassium ATPase in principal cells.
title: Aldosterone action
zh: 醛固酮會增加遠端腎元的鈉再吸收與鉀分泌。它能促進主細胞中上皮鈉離子通道及鈉鉀幫浦的表現與活性。

source: Arterial baroreceptors respond strongly to rapid changes in blood pressure but adapt during sustained pressure changes. Therefore, the baroreflex is especially important for short-term regulation and is less effective as the sole mechanism for long-term blood pressure control.
title: Baroreceptor adaptation
zh: 動脈壓力感受器會對血壓的快速變化產生強烈反應，但在壓力持續改變時會逐漸適應。因此，壓力感受器反射對短期調節特別重要；若單獨依靠它來長期控制血壓，效果則較有限。

source: Hormones circulate widely, but only cells that express the appropriate receptors respond directly. The same hormone may also produce different effects in different tissues because receptor subtypes and downstream signaling proteins vary among cell types.
title: Endocrine receptor specificity
zh: 荷爾蒙會隨循環廣泛分布，但只有表現相應受體的細胞能直接回應。同一種荷爾蒙也可能在不同組織產生不同效應，因為各種細胞的受體亞型與下游訊號蛋白並不相同。

source: After a cytosolic calcium signal, calcium must be removed to restore the resting state. Plasma membrane pumps and exchangers export calcium, while SERCA pumps return calcium to the endoplasmic or sarcoplasmic reticulum. Mitochondria can also transiently take up calcium.
title: Calcium removal
zh: 細胞質出現鈣離子訊號後，必須移除鈣離子才能恢復靜止狀態。細胞膜上的幫浦與交換器會將鈣離子送出細胞，肌漿網／內質網鈣離子幫浦則將其送回內質網或肌漿網。粒線體也能暫時攝取鈣離子。

source: Central chemoreceptors respond primarily to changes in carbon dioxide through changes in hydrogen ion concentration in cerebrospinal fluid. Peripheral chemoreceptors also respond to low arterial oxygen, especially when oxygen tension falls substantially.
title: Respiratory control
zh: 中樞化學感受器主要透過腦脊髓液中氫離子濃度的改變，對二氧化碳變化產生反應。周邊化學感受器也會對動脈低氧反應，尤其在氧分壓明顯下降時。

source: During dynamic exercise, cardiac output rises because heart rate and stroke volume increase. Blood flow is redistributed toward active skeletal muscle, while local metabolites promote vasodilation and improve oxygen delivery to working tissue.
title: Exercise physiology
zh: 動態運動時，心率與每搏量增加，使心輸出量上升。血流會重新分配至活躍的骨骼肌，同時局部代謝物促進血管擴張，改善工作中組織的氧氣供應。

source: Changes in afferent arteriolar tone help stabilize glomerular filtration. Myogenic responses react to vessel stretch, while tubuloglomerular feedback uses sodium chloride delivery to the macula densa as a signal related to filtration and tubular flow.
title: Renal autoregulation II
zh: 入球小動脈張力的變化有助於穩定腎絲球過濾。肌源性反應會回應血管受到的伸展；管球回饋則利用到達緻密斑的氯化鈉量，作為與過濾及腎小管液流量相關的訊號。

source: The effect of an ion on membrane voltage depends on both its equilibrium potential and the membrane conductance for that ion. Opening a channel drives the membrane potential toward the equilibrium potential of the ion carried by that channel.
title: Membrane excitability
zh: 某種離子對膜電位的影響，同時取決於該離子的平衡電位，以及細胞膜對該離子的電導。通道開啟時，會使膜電位朝向該通道所傳遞離子的平衡電位移動。

source: Smooth muscle contraction is regulated primarily through calcium-calmodulin activation of myosin light-chain kinase. Unlike skeletal muscle, smooth muscle does not use troponin as the main calcium-sensitive regulatory protein.
title: Smooth muscle
zh: 平滑肌收縮主要由鈣離子－鈣調蛋白活化肌凝蛋白輕鏈激酶來調控。與骨骼肌不同，平滑肌不以肌鈣蛋白作為主要的鈣敏感性調節蛋白。

source: Edema can develop when capillary hydrostatic pressure rises, plasma oncotic pressure falls, capillary permeability increases, or lymphatic drainage is impaired. These mechanisms all favor net movement or retention of fluid in the interstitial space.
title: Edema formation
zh: 微血管靜水壓上升、血漿膠體滲透壓下降、微血管通透性增加，或淋巴引流受阻時，都可能形成水腫。這些機制皆會促進液體淨移入或滯留於組織間隙。

source: In an ideal plug-flow reactor, fluid elements move through the reactor with negligible axial mixing. Reactant concentration therefore changes continuously along the reactor length. For many positive-order reactions, this concentration profile allows a plug-flow reactor to achieve a desired conversion with a smaller volume than a continuously stirred tank reactor.
title: Plug-flow reactor
zh: 在理想的栓塞流反應器中，流體微元沿著反應器移動，軸向混合可忽略不計。因此，反應物濃度會沿反應器長度連續改變。對許多正反應級數的反應而言，這種濃度分布使栓塞流反應器能以比連續攪拌槽反應器更小的體積，達到所需的轉化率。

source: Counter-current heat exchangers often provide a larger average temperature driving force than co-current designs. Because the hot and cold streams flow in opposite directions, the temperature difference can remain substantial along the exchanger length, improving heat-transfer performance for a given area.
title: Heat exchanger
zh: 逆流式熱交換器通常比並流式設計具有更大的平均溫度驅動力。由於冷、熱流體朝相反方向流動，沿著熱交換器全長仍可維持相當大的溫差，因此在傳熱面積相同時，能改善熱傳性能。

source: Mass transfer occurs when a species moves in response to a concentration or chemical-potential gradient. Molecular diffusion is described by Fick’s law, while convection can transport species with the bulk motion of a fluid. Many industrial separations depend on both mechanisms.
title: Mass transfer
zh: 當某一物種因濃度梯度或化學勢梯度而移動時，就會發生質量傳遞。分子擴散可用費克定律描述，而對流則能隨著流體的整體運動輸送物種。許多工業分離操作都同時依賴這兩種機制。

source: Raoult’s law describes vapor-liquid equilibrium for an ideal liquid mixture. Real mixtures often deviate from ideality because interactions between unlike molecules differ from interactions between like molecules. Activity coefficients are introduced to account for this non-ideal behavior.
title: Non-ideal solutions
zh: 拉午耳定律描述理想液體混合物的氣液平衡。真實混合物經常偏離理想行為，因為不同種類分子之間的作用力，與相同種類分子之間的作用力不同。為了描述這種非理想行為，計算中會引入活性係數。

source: Feedback control uses measurements of a process output to adjust an input and reduce deviation from a desired set point. Proportional, integral, and derivative actions influence the speed, offset, and stability of the closed-loop response in different ways.
title: Process control
zh: 回授控制利用製程輸出的量測值來調整輸入，使輸出與期望設定值之間的偏差縮小。比例、積分與微分作用，會以不同方式影響閉迴路響應的速度、穩態偏差與穩定性。

source: Reducing catalyst particle size can shorten internal diffusion distances and increase external surface area. However, very small particles in a packed bed can create a large pressure drop. Reactor design therefore requires a compromise between reaction performance and hydraulic resistance.
title: Catalyst particles
zh: 減小觸媒粒徑，可以縮短內部擴散距離並增加外部表面積。然而，在填充床中，過小的顆粒可能造成很大的壓降。因此，反應器設計必須在反應效能與流動阻力之間取得折衷。

source: Distillation separates components by repeatedly contacting vapor and liquid phases. Separation becomes easier when the components have a large relative volatility. The number of equilibrium stages and the reflux ratio both influence the purity and energy requirement of a distillation column.
title: Distillation
zh: 蒸餾藉由讓氣相與液相反覆接觸來分離成分。當各成分之間的相對揮發度較大時，分離會比較容易。平衡級數與回流比都會影響蒸餾塔的產品純度及能源需求。

source: Chemical potential is the partial molar Gibbs energy of a component in a mixture. Differences in chemical potential provide a driving force for mass transfer and chemical reaction. At phase equilibrium, the chemical potential of each component is equal in all coexisting phases.
title: Chemical potential
zh: 化學勢是混合物中某一成分的偏莫耳吉布斯能。化學勢差提供質量傳遞與化學反應的驅動力。在相平衡時，每一成分在所有共存相中的化學勢都相等。

source: Fugacity is introduced to describe the escaping tendency of a real gas in a form that resembles pressure in ideal-gas equations. At low pressure the fugacity approaches the pressure. At higher pressure, intermolecular interactions cause the two quantities to differ.
title: Fugacity
zh: 逸度是為了描述真實氣體的逸出傾向而引入的物理量，其形式類似理想氣體方程式中的壓力。在低壓下，逸度接近壓力；在較高壓力下，分子間的交互作用會使這兩個量產生差異。

source: The activity coefficient corrects liquid-phase composition for non-ideal molecular interactions. A value near unity indicates nearly ideal behavior, while significant deviations indicate that unlike and like molecular interactions are not equivalent. Activity coefficients are widely used in vapor-liquid equilibrium calculations.
title: Activity coefficient
zh: 活性係數用來修正液相組成，以反映非理想的分子間交互作用。數值接近一，表示行為近似理想；若明顯偏離一，則表示不同種類分子與相同種類分子之間的交互作用並不相同。活性係數廣泛用於氣液平衡計算。

source: A non-isothermal continuously stirred tank reactor may exhibit strong coupling between reaction kinetics and heat transfer. For an exothermic reaction, heat generation can rise rapidly with temperature, while heat removal depends on the cooling system. This interaction can produce multiple steady states.
title: CSTR energy balance
zh: 非等溫的連續攪拌槽反應器，可能呈現反應動力學與熱傳之間的強烈耦合。對放熱反應而言，產熱速率可能隨溫度快速增加，而移熱速率則取決於冷卻系統。這種相互作用可能導致多個穩態。

source: Real reactors may deviate from ideal plug flow or complete mixing. Residence-time distribution experiments use a tracer to determine how long fluid elements remain inside a vessel. The resulting distribution can reveal bypassing, dead zones, or excessive mixing.
title: Residence-time distribution
zh: 真實反應器可能偏離理想栓塞流或完全混合的行為。停留時間分布實驗利用示蹤劑，判定流體微元在槽體內停留多久。所得的分布可揭示短路流、死區或過度混合等現象。

source: A porous catalyst particle can experience concentration gradients when reaction inside the pores is fast compared with diffusion. Under these conditions, not all active sites are used equally. The effectiveness factor provides a measure of the reduction in observed reaction rate caused by internal diffusion resistance.
title: Catalyst diffusion
zh: 當多孔觸媒孔隙內的反應相對於擴散非常快速時，顆粒內部可能出現濃度梯度。在這種情況下，各活性位點並未被同等程度地利用。有效因子可用來衡量內部擴散阻力造成的觀測反應速率下降程度。

source: Pressure decreases along a pipe because mechanical energy is dissipated by viscous effects. In laminar flow the pressure drop has a strong dependence on pipe radius, whereas turbulent pressure loss depends on Reynolds number and surface roughness through the friction factor.
title: Pipe pressure drop
zh: 由於黏滯效應會耗散機械能，流體沿管道流動時壓力會逐漸降低。在層流中，壓降對管半徑有很強的依賴性；在紊流中，壓力損失則透過摩擦因子，受到雷諾數與管壁表面粗糙度的影響。

source: Cavitation can occur when the local pressure in a pump falls below the liquid vapor pressure. Vapor bubbles form and later collapse as they enter regions of higher pressure. Repeated collapse can damage equipment and reduce hydraulic performance.
title: Cavitation
zh: 當泵內局部壓力降到液體的蒸氣壓以下時，可能發生氣蝕。此時會形成蒸氣泡，而氣泡進入壓力較高的區域後又會崩塌。反覆的崩塌可能損壞設備，並降低水力性能。

source: The overall heat-transfer coefficient combines several thermal resistances, including convection on both sides of a wall, conduction through the wall, and fouling. A large resistance in any one step can control the overall heat-transfer rate.
title: Overall heat transfer
zh: 總熱傳係數整合了多種熱阻，包括壁面兩側的對流、穿過壁面的熱傳導，以及污垢造成的熱阻。任何一個步驟的熱阻若特別大，都可能控制整體熱傳速率。

source: Transient heat conduction occurs when temperature inside a solid changes with time. The Biot number compares internal conduction resistance with external convection resistance, while the Fourier number measures the extent of thermal diffusion over time.
title: Transient conduction
zh: 當固體內部的溫度隨時間改變時，就會發生暫態熱傳導。畢奧數用來比較內部傳導熱阻與外部對流熱阻，而傅立葉數則衡量熱量隨時間擴散的程度。

source: Increasing the reflux ratio in a distillation column generally improves separation at a given number of stages, but it also increases condenser and reboiler duties. Design therefore requires a compromise between capital cost, energy use, and separation performance.
title: Distillation reflux
zh: 在蒸餾塔中，提高回流比通常能在級數相同時改善分離效果，但也會增加冷凝器與再沸器的熱負荷。因此，設計時必須在設備投資成本、能源使用及分離性能之間取得折衷。

source: Gas absorption transfers a soluble component from a gas phase into a liquid solvent. Counter-current operation maintains a larger concentration driving force over much of the column. The required height depends on equilibrium behavior and mass-transfer performance.
title: Absorption column
zh: 氣體吸收是將可溶性成分由氣相轉移到液體溶劑中的操作。逆流操作能在塔內大部分區域維持較大的濃度驅動力。所需塔高取決於平衡行為與質量傳遞性能。

source: Membrane processes separate species because components have different rates of transport through a selective barrier. Pressure, concentration, or electrical potential may provide the driving force, depending on the membrane process and the species being separated.
title: Membrane separation
zh: 膜分離程序利用各成分通過選擇性屏障時的傳輸速率差異來分離物種。依膜程序與待分離物種的不同，驅動力可能來自壓力、濃度或電位差。

source: A feedback controller acts on the difference between a measured process variable and its set point. Integral action can remove steady-state offset, but excessive integral action may produce oscillation or windup when an actuator saturates.
title: Feedback control
zh: 回授控制器會根據量測到的製程變數與設定值之間的差異採取動作。積分作用可以消除穩態偏差，但過強的積分作用可能造成振盪，或在致動器飽和時產生積分飽和現象。

source: Dead time is a delay between a change in manipulated input and the first observable change in process output. Long dead time makes feedback control more difficult because corrective action is based on information that is already old.
title: Dead time
zh: 死時間是操控輸入改變後，到製程輸出首次出現可觀測變化之間的延遲。死時間越長，回授控制越困難，因為修正動作所依據的資訊已經過時。

source: Dimensional analysis reduces a large set of variables into a smaller set of dimensionless groups. These groups help identify similarity between systems of different scales and are widely used to correlate transport and fluid-flow data.
title: Dimensional analysis
zh: 因次分析可將大量變數化為較少的無因次群。這些無因次群有助於辨識不同尺度系統之間的相似性，並廣泛用來建立傳輸與流體流動數據的關聯式。

source: Reverse osmosis applies hydraulic pressure to overcome the natural osmotic driving force across a semipermeable membrane. Water preferentially permeates the membrane while many dissolved salts are retained, making the process useful for desalination.
title: Reverse osmosis
zh: 逆滲透施加水力壓力，以克服半透膜兩側自然產生的滲透驅動力。水會優先透過膜，而許多溶解的鹽類會被截留，因此這項程序可用於海水淡化。

source: Crystallization requires a supersaturated solution. The degree of supersaturation influences both nucleation and crystal growth, so cooling rate, evaporation, and seeding can strongly affect the final crystal-size distribution.
title: Crystallization
zh: 結晶需要過飽和溶液。過飽和程度會同時影響成核與晶體成長，因此冷卻速率、蒸發及晶種添加，都可能強烈影響最終的晶體粒徑分布。

source: A steady-flow energy balance accounts for enthalpy carried by inlet and outlet streams as well as heat transfer, shaft work, and changes in kinetic and potential energy. Different process units simplify this balance in different ways.
title: Energy balance
zh: 穩流能量衡算除了考慮入口與出口流體攜帶的焓，也包含熱傳、軸功，以及動能與位能的變化。不同製程單元可依各自條件，以不同方式簡化這項衡算。

source: Real processes generate entropy because of irreversibilities such as friction, mixing, chemical reaction, and heat transfer across a finite temperature difference. Entropy generation provides a measure of lost work potential.
title: Entropy generation
zh: 真實程序會因摩擦、混合、化學反應，以及跨越有限溫差的熱傳等不可逆性而產生熵。熵產生量可以用來衡量作功能力的損失。

source: A throttling valve reduces pressure without producing shaft work. If heat transfer and kinetic and potential energy changes are negligible, the process is approximately isenthalpic even though it is highly irreversible.
title: Throttling process
zh: 節流閥會降低壓力，但不產生軸功。如果熱傳以及動能、位能的變化可以忽略，即使此程序具有高度不可逆性，仍可近似視為等焓程序。

source: At phase equilibrium, each chemical species has the same chemical potential in all coexisting phases. In practical calculations this condition is often expressed by equality of fugacity between the vapor and liquid phases.
title: Vapor liquid equilibrium
zh: 在相平衡時，每一化學物種在所有共存相中都具有相同的化學勢。在實際計算中，這項條件通常以氣相與液相中的逸度相等來表示。

source: An azeotrope has the same vapor and liquid composition at a particular condition. Because the relative volatility approaches unity at that point, ordinary distillation cannot pass through the azeotropic composition.
title: Azeotropic mixture
zh: 共沸混合物在特定條件下具有相同的氣相與液相組成。由於在該點的相對揮發度趨近於一，普通蒸餾無法跨越共沸組成。

source: Reaction order describes how the rate depends on reactant concentration and must generally be determined from kinetics. It is not necessarily equal to the stoichiometric coefficient unless the reaction step is elementary.
title: Reaction order
zh: 反應級數描述反應速率如何依賴反應物濃度，通常必須由動力學研究決定。除非該反應步驟是基本反應，否則反應級數不一定等於化學計量係數。

source: A continuously stirred tank reactor is assumed to be perfectly mixed, so the outlet composition is the same as the reactor composition. The reaction rate used in its design equation is therefore evaluated at the exit conditions.
title: CSTR design
zh: 連續攪拌槽反應器假設為完全混合，因此出口組成與反應器內部組成相同。其設計方程式所使用的反應速率，也因此必須以出口條件來計算。

source: In an ideal plug-flow reactor, concentration and temperature may change continuously with axial position. A differential mole balance relates the change in molar flow to the local reaction rate along the reactor volume.
title: PFR design
zh: 在理想的栓塞流反應器中，濃度與溫度可能沿軸向位置連續改變。微分莫耳衡算將莫耳流率的變化，與反應器各體積位置的局部反應速率連結起來。

source: Porous catalyst particles can experience internal diffusion resistance when reaction is faster than transport through the pores. Increasing particle size can strengthen this limitation even when the intrinsic catalyst chemistry is unchanged.
title: Catalyst diffusion
zh: 當反應速率快於物質通過孔隙的傳輸速率時，多孔觸媒顆粒可能受到內部擴散阻力的限制。即使觸媒本身的化學性質不變，增大粒徑也可能加劇這種限制。

source: Pressure drop through a packed bed depends on fluid properties, superficial velocity, particle diameter, and bed void fraction. Very small particles improve external area but can greatly increase hydraulic resistance.
title: Packed-bed pressure drop
zh: 填充床的壓降取決於流體性質、表觀速度、顆粒直徑，以及床層空隙率。非常小的顆粒可以增加外部表面積，但也可能大幅增加流動阻力。

source: In fully developed laminar flow through a circular pipe, viscous effects dominate and the velocity profile is parabolic. The maximum centerline velocity is twice the average velocity for this ideal case.
title: Laminar flow
zh: 在圓管內充分發展的層流中，黏滯效應占主導地位，速度分布呈拋物線形。在這種理想情況下，管中心的最大速度是平均速度的兩倍。

source: Turbulence produces eddies that increase mixing and enhance momentum, heat, and mass transfer. This improvement in transfer rates is usually accompanied by a larger pressure drop and higher pumping demand.
title: Turbulent transport
zh: 紊流會產生渦流，增加混合，並強化動量、熱量與質量的傳遞。這種傳輸速率的改善，通常也伴隨較大的壓降與較高的泵送需求。

source: Heat transfer through a wall with convection on both sides can be represented as thermal resistances in series. The overall heat-transfer coefficient combines these resistances into a single engineering parameter.
title: Heat-transfer resistance
zh: 熱量穿過兩側都有對流的壁面時，可以用串聯熱阻來表示。總熱傳係數將這些熱阻整合為單一的工程參數。

source: The Biot number compares internal conductive resistance with external convective resistance. When the Biot number is very small, internal temperature gradients are limited and a lumped-capacitance approximation may be reasonable.
title: Biot number
zh: 畢奧數用來比較內部傳導熱阻與外部對流熱阻。當畢奧數非常小時，內部溫度梯度有限，此時採用集總熱容量近似可能是合理的。

source: Fickian diffusion occurs in response to a concentration or chemical-potential gradient. The diffusion coefficient depends on the molecular species, medium, temperature, and other physical conditions.
title: Diffusion
zh: 費克型擴散由濃度梯度或化學勢梯度所驅動。擴散係數取決於分子種類、介質、溫度，以及其他物理條件。

source: Pressure-driven membrane processes separate species according to differences in permeability, size, charge, or solubility. Concentration polarization and fouling can reduce flux and alter selectivity during operation.
title: Membrane separation
zh: 壓力驅動的膜程序，依據透過性、尺寸、電荷或溶解度的差異來分離物種。在操作過程中，濃度極化與膜污堵可能降低通量，並改變選擇性。

source: Increasing reflux generally improves separation in a distillation column because more liquid is returned for internal contacting. However, higher reflux also increases condenser and reboiler energy duties.
title: Distillation reflux
zh: 提高回流量通常能改善蒸餾塔的分離效果，因為有更多液體返回塔內，參與內部接觸。然而，較高的回流量也會增加冷凝器與再沸器的能源負荷。

source: In gas absorption, a solute transfers from the gas phase into a liquid solvent. Performance depends on phase equilibrium, interfacial area, mass-transfer coefficients, solvent flow rate, and hydrodynamic limits such as flooding.
title: Absorption column
zh: 在氣體吸收中，溶質會從氣相轉移到液體溶劑中。吸收性能取決於相平衡、相間接觸面積、質傳係數、溶劑流率，以及液泛等流體力學限制。

source: Drying often begins with a constant-rate period controlled mainly by external transfer. As the material becomes drier, internal moisture movement becomes limiting and the process enters a falling-rate period.
title: Drying
zh: 乾燥通常從主要受外部傳輸控制的恆速乾燥期開始。隨著材料逐漸變乾，內部水分移動會成為限制步驟，程序也就進入降速乾燥期。

source: Proportional action responds to current error, integral action responds to accumulated error, and derivative action responds to the rate of change. Their combination can improve performance but poor tuning can create oscillation or instability.
title: PID control
zh: 比例作用對目前的誤差作出反應，積分作用對累積誤差作出反應，而微分作用則對誤差的變化速率作出反應。三者結合可以改善控制性能，但調校不當可能造成振盪或不穩定。

source: Process dead time is a delay between a change in input and the first observable response in the measured output. Large dead time makes feedback control more difficult because corrective actions are based on outdated information.
title: Dead time
zh: 製程死時間是輸入改變後，到量測輸出首次出現可觀測響應之間的延遲。較長的死時間會使回授控制更加困難，因為修正動作是根據已經過時的資訊來決定。

source: HPLC separates analytes through different interactions with the stationary and mobile phases. Retention time is method-dependent, while resolution depends on column efficiency, retention, and selectivity.
title: HPLC separation
zh: 高效液相層析利用分析物與固定相、移動相之間交互作用的差異來分離物質。滯留時間取決於分析方法，而解析度則取決於管柱效率、滯留程度與選擇性。

source: Gas adsorption measurements can be interpreted with the BET model to estimate specific surface area. The result is widely used for porous catalysts, powders, and adsorbents, although model assumptions and pressure range must be considered.
title: BET surface area
zh: 氣體吸附量測可以用布朗諾、埃米特與泰勒模型加以解讀，估算比表面積。這項結果廣泛用於多孔觸媒、粉體與吸附劑，但必須考慮模型的假設及適用的壓力範圍。

source: Non-Newtonian materials can show shear thinning, shear thickening, yield stress, or viscoelastic behavior. A rheometer can characterize these responses over a range of controlled stresses, shear rates, or oscillatory conditions.
title: Rheology
zh: 非牛頓材料可能呈現剪切變稀、剪切增稠、降伏應力或黏彈性行為。流變儀可以在一系列受控制的應力、剪切速率或振盪條件下，量測並描述這些響應。

source: Oxidative phosphorylation couples electron transfer to ATP synthesis. As electrons pass through the mitochondrial respiratory chain, protons are pumped across the inner membrane. The resulting electrochemical gradient drives protons back through ATP synthase, providing the energy required to form ATP.
title: Oxidative phosphorylation
zh: 氧化磷酸化將電子傳遞與三磷酸腺苷的合成耦合在一起。當電子通過粒線體呼吸鏈時，質子會被泵送到內膜的另一側。由此形成的電化學梯度驅使質子經由三磷酸腺苷合成酶流回，提供形成三磷酸腺苷所需的能量。

source: Protein abundance is determined by both synthesis and degradation. A stable messenger RNA level does not guarantee stable protein expression because translation efficiency, protein folding, ubiquitination, and proteasomal degradation can change independently of transcription.
title: Protein degradation
zh: 蛋白質的含量由合成與降解共同決定。信使核糖核酸的含量穩定，並不保證蛋白質表現量也穩定，因為轉譯效率、蛋白質摺疊、泛素化及蛋白酶體降解，都可能在不受轉錄變化影響的情況下各自改變。

source: Cell signaling pathways often use phosphorylation to transmit information. A receptor can activate a kinase cascade that amplifies an extracellular signal, while phosphatases and inhibitory proteins help terminate the response. The final outcome depends on both signal strength and duration.
title: Cell signaling
zh: 細胞訊息傳遞路徑經常利用磷酸化來傳遞資訊。受體可以啟動激酶級聯反應，放大細胞外的訊號；磷酸酶與抑制性蛋白則協助終止反應。最終結果同時取決於訊號的強度與持續時間。

source: The intrinsic apoptotic pathway is strongly influenced by mitochondrial outer-membrane permeabilization. Release of cytochrome c promotes apoptosome formation and caspase activation. Members of the BCL-2 protein family regulate whether this mitochondrial checkpoint is crossed.
title: Apoptosis
zh: 內源性細胞凋亡路徑受到粒線體外膜通透化的強烈影響。細胞色素丙的釋放會促進凋亡小體形成與半胱天冬酶活化。乙型細胞淋巴瘤二型蛋白家族的成員，調控細胞是否跨越這個粒線體檢查關卡。

source: The Michaelis-Menten model relates reaction velocity to substrate concentration for a simple enzyme-catalyzed reaction. The parameter Vmax reflects the maximal rate at saturating substrate, whereas Km is the substrate concentration at which the velocity reaches half of Vmax.
title: Enzyme kinetics
zh: 米氏動力學模型描述簡單酵素催化反應中，反應速率與受質濃度的關係。最大反應速率參數反映受質飽和時的最高速率，而米氏常數則是反應速率達到最大反應速率一半時的受質濃度。

source: AMP-activated protein kinase functions as a cellular energy sensor. When energy availability falls, AMPK promotes pathways that generate ATP and suppresses energy-consuming biosynthetic pathways. This helps cells restore energy balance during metabolic stress.
title: AMPK signaling
zh: 單磷酸腺苷活化蛋白激酶具有細胞能量感測器的功能。當可用能量下降時，它會促進產生三磷酸腺苷的路徑，並抑制消耗能量的生物合成路徑。這有助於細胞在代謝壓力下恢復能量平衡。

source: Nrf2 is a transcription factor that coordinates antioxidant defense. Under basal conditions it is continuously targeted for degradation by a Keap1-dependent mechanism. Oxidative or electrophilic stress stabilizes Nrf2, allowing it to accumulate in the nucleus and activate protective genes.
title: Nrf2 response
zh: 核因子紅系二相關因子二是一種協調抗氧化防禦的轉錄因子。在基礎狀態下，它持續被一種依賴克爾奇樣相關蛋白一的機制標記並降解。氧化壓力或親電子壓力會使這個轉錄因子穩定，讓它累積於細胞核中，並活化具有保護作用的基因。

source: Mitochondria continually undergo fusion and fission. Fusion can help maintain function by mixing mitochondrial contents, while fission can isolate damaged regions and facilitate their removal by mitophagy. An imbalance in these processes can disturb cellular homeostasis.
title: Mitochondrial dynamics
zh: 粒線體持續進行融合與分裂。融合可藉由混合粒線體內容物來協助維持功能；分裂則可以隔離受損區域，並促進粒線體自噬將它們清除。這些過程失衡，可能擾亂細胞恆定。

source: Mitophagy is the selective autophagic removal of damaged or unnecessary mitochondria. By preventing the accumulation of dysfunctional organelles, mitophagy helps control mitochondrial quality, reactive oxygen species, and cellular stress responses.
title: Mitophagy
zh: 粒線體自噬是選擇性地透過自噬，移除受損或不再需要的粒線體。藉由避免功能失常的胞器累積，粒線體自噬有助於控制粒線體品質、活性氧，以及細胞的壓力反應。

source: Reactive oxygen species are not only toxic by-products. At controlled levels, oxidants such as hydrogen peroxide can reversibly modify proteins and participate in signal transduction. Oxidative stress occurs when oxidant production exceeds the capacity of antioxidant and repair systems.
title: Redox signaling
zh: 活性氧不只是具有毒性的副產物。在受到控制的濃度下，過氧化氫等氧化物可以可逆地修飾蛋白質，並參與訊息傳遞。當氧化物的產生量超過抗氧化與修復系統的處理能力時，就會發生氧化壓力。

source: Reduced glutathione is an important cellular antioxidant. It donates reducing equivalents to reactions that detoxify peroxides and becomes oxidized in the process. The balance between reduced and oxidized glutathione is one indicator of cellular redox state.
title: Glutathione
zh: 還原型穀胱甘肽是重要的細胞抗氧化物。它向清除過氧化物的反應提供還原當量，並在過程中被氧化。還原型與氧化型穀胱甘肽之間的平衡，是細胞氧化還原狀態的一項指標。

source: Cells possess multiple DNA-repair pathways that recognize different types of damage. If damage cannot be repaired, checkpoint pathways can delay the cell cycle or promote apoptosis. Defects in these systems can increase mutation burden and genomic instability.
title: DNA repair
zh: 細胞具有多種去氧核糖核酸修復路徑，可辨識不同類型的損傷。如果損傷無法修復，檢查點路徑可以延緩細胞週期，或促進細胞凋亡。這些系統出現缺陷時，可能增加突變負荷與基因組不穩定性。

source: Alternative splicing allows a single gene to produce multiple messenger RNA isoforms. By changing which exons are included, cells can generate proteins with different structures, localization, or functions without changing the underlying DNA sequence.
title: Alternative splicing
zh: 選擇性剪接讓單一基因能產生多種信使核糖核酸異構型。藉由改變哪些外顯子被保留下來，細胞不必改變原有的去氧核糖核酸序列，就能產生結構、定位或功能不同的蛋白質。

source: MicroRNAs are short regulatory RNAs that guide protein complexes to target messenger RNAs. Partial base pairing can reduce translation and promote mRNA destabilization, allowing a single microRNA to influence many genes in a regulatory network.
title: MicroRNA
zh: 微小核糖核酸是短鏈的調控性核糖核酸，能引導蛋白質複合體辨識目標信使核糖核酸。部分鹼基配對可以降低轉譯，並促進信使核糖核酸失去穩定性，使單一微小核糖核酸能影響調控網路中的許多基因。

source: Ubiquitination is a reversible post-translational modification. Polyubiquitin chains can target proteins to the proteasome for degradation, while other ubiquitin patterns can regulate trafficking, DNA repair, or signaling without necessarily causing degradation.
title: Ubiquitin system
zh: 泛素化是一種可逆的轉譯後修飾。多聚泛素鏈可以將蛋白質導向蛋白酶體進行降解；其他泛素修飾形式則可以調控胞內運輸、去氧核糖核酸修復或訊息傳遞，而不一定造成蛋白質降解。

source: The unfolded protein response is activated when the endoplasmic reticulum accumulates misfolded proteins. Its initial goal is to restore homeostasis by reducing protein load and increasing folding capacity. If stress remains severe, the response can contribute to apoptosis.
title: ER stress
zh: 當內質網累積錯誤摺疊的蛋白質時，未摺疊蛋白反應就會被啟動。其最初目標是降低蛋白質負荷，並增加摺疊能力，以恢復細胞恆定。如果壓力持續嚴重，這項反應也可能促進細胞凋亡。

source: Cell-cycle checkpoints prevent cells from progressing when DNA is damaged or replication is incomplete. The p53-p21 pathway can block cell-cycle progression after damage, providing time for repair or promoting senescence and apoptosis when damage is severe.
title: Cell-cycle checkpoint
zh: 當去氧核糖核酸受損或複製尚未完成時，細胞週期檢查點會阻止細胞繼續前進。損傷發生後，腫瘤抑制蛋白五十三與細胞週期抑制蛋白二十一所構成的路徑，可以阻擋細胞週期進程，爭取修復時間；若損傷嚴重，則可促進細胞衰老與凋亡。

source: Many cancer cells maintain high rates of glycolysis and lactate production even when oxygen is available. This metabolic pattern can support rapid growth by providing ATP and biosynthetic intermediates, although tumors remain metabolically heterogeneous.
title: Warburg metabolism
zh: 許多癌細胞即使在有氧的情況下，仍維持高速率的糖解作用與乳酸生成。這種代謝模式可藉由提供三磷酸腺苷與生物合成中間產物，支持快速生長；不過，各腫瘤的代謝仍具有異質性。

source: Different modes of enzyme inhibition produce distinct kinetic patterns. Competitive inhibitors raise the apparent substrate requirement without changing maximal velocity, whereas pure noncompetitive inhibitors reduce maximal velocity while leaving Km unchanged.
title: Enzyme inhibition
zh: 不同的酵素抑制模式會產生不同的動力學特徵。競爭型抑制劑會提高表觀受質需求，但不改變最大反應速率；純非競爭型抑制劑則會降低最大反應速率，而讓米氏常數維持不變。

source: Protein function often depends on subcellular localization. Signal sequences, lipid modifications, and protein-protein interactions can direct proteins to the nucleus, mitochondria, endoplasmic reticulum, plasma membrane, or other compartments.
title: Protein localization
zh: 蛋白質的功能經常取決於它在細胞內的位置。訊號序列、脂質修飾及蛋白質之間的交互作用，可以將蛋白質導向細胞核、粒線體、內質網、細胞膜或其他區室。

source: Mitochondria can take up calcium from the cytosol, especially near sites of calcium release from the endoplasmic reticulum. Moderate calcium uptake can stimulate metabolism, whereas excessive mitochondrial calcium can contribute to permeability transition and cell injury.
title: Mitochondrial calcium
zh: 粒線體可以從細胞質攝取鈣離子，尤其是在靠近內質網釋放鈣離子的位置。適度的鈣離子攝取可以刺激代謝，但過量的粒線體鈣離子則可能促成通透性轉變與細胞損傷。

source: Autophagy delivers cytoplasmic material to lysosomes for degradation and recycling. It often supports survival during nutrient deprivation or stress, but its effect depends on context and should not automatically be interpreted as a form of cell death.
title: Autophagy
zh: 自噬將細胞質中的物質送往溶小體，進行降解與回收。它通常有助於細胞在營養缺乏或壓力下存活，但其作用取決於情境，不應一律將它解讀為一種細胞死亡方式。

source: Signal-transduction pathways often contain amplification, feedback, and cross-talk. The same receptor can produce different outcomes depending on cell type, signal strength, duration, and the availability of downstream signaling proteins.
title: Receptor signaling
zh: 訊息傳遞路徑經常包含訊號放大、回饋與交互調控。同一種受體可能因細胞類型、訊號強度、持續時間，以及下游訊息傳遞蛋白的可用性不同，而產生不同結果。

source: As substrate concentration increases, the rate of a simple enzyme-catalyzed reaction approaches a maximum value. At high substrate concentrations, most active sites are occupied and adding more substrate produces little additional increase in reaction velocity.
title: Enzyme saturation
zh: 隨著受質濃度增加，簡單酵素催化反應的速率會逐漸接近最大值。在高受質濃度下，大多數活性位點已被占據，再加入更多受質，也只能使反應速率增加很少。

source: A competitive inhibitor binds to the active site and reduces the apparent ability of the enzyme to bind substrate. Increasing substrate concentration can overcome the inhibition, so the apparent Km increases while the ideal Vmax remains unchanged.
title: Competitive inhibition
zh: 競爭型抑制劑會結合活性位點，降低酵素與受質結合的表觀能力。提高受質濃度可以克服這種抑制，因此表觀米氏常數增加，而理想情況下的最大反應速率維持不變。

source: Allosteric enzymes can respond cooperatively to substrate or regulatory molecules. Their activity may change sharply over a narrow concentration range, allowing metabolic pathways to respond sensitively to cellular conditions.
title: Allosteric regulation
zh: 異位調節酵素可以對受質或調控分子產生協同性反應。它們的活性可能在很小的濃度變化範圍內急劇改變，讓代謝路徑能靈敏地回應細胞狀態。

source: Phosphofructokinase-1 is a major regulatory enzyme in glycolysis. High ATP can inhibit the enzyme, whereas AMP and fructose-2,6-bisphosphate promote activity. This helps match glycolytic flux to energy demand.
title: Glycolytic control
zh: 磷酸果糖激酶一是糖解作用的重要調控酵素。高濃度的三磷酸腺苷可以抑制它，而單磷酸腺苷與果糖－二、六－二磷酸則會促進其活性。這有助於讓糖解通量配合能量需求。

source: Electrons from NADH and FADH2 move through the respiratory chain to oxygen. The released energy drives proton pumping across the inner mitochondrial membrane, creating a proton-motive force that powers ATP synthase.
title: Mitochondrial respiration
zh: 來自還原型菸鹼醯胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸與還原型黃素腺嘌呤二核苷酸的電子，會經由呼吸鏈傳遞給氧。過程中釋放的能量驅動質子跨越粒線體內膜的泵送，建立質子動力勢，為三磷酸腺苷合成酶提供動力。

source: An uncoupler dissipates the proton gradient across the inner mitochondrial membrane. Electron transport and oxygen consumption may increase, but ATP synthesis becomes less efficient because the proton-motive force is no longer tightly coupled to ATP production.
title: Uncoupling
zh: 解偶聯劑會消散粒線體內膜兩側的質子梯度。電子傳遞與耗氧量可能增加，但三磷酸腺苷合成的效率會降低，因為質子動力勢不再與三磷酸腺苷的生成緊密耦合。

source: The pentose phosphate pathway generates NADPH and ribose-5-phosphate. NADPH supports reductive biosynthesis and antioxidant defense, while ribose-5-phosphate contributes to nucleotide synthesis.
title: Pentose phosphate pathway
zh: 磷酸戊糖途徑會產生還原型菸鹼醯胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸磷酸與核糖五－磷酸。前者支持還原性生物合成與抗氧化防禦，後者則參與核苷酸合成。

source: A protein sequence contains the information needed to adopt a functional structure, but folding in cells is also assisted by molecular chaperones. Misfolded proteins may be refolded, sequestered, or targeted for degradation.
title: Protein folding
zh: 蛋白質序列含有形成具有功能之結構所需的資訊，但細胞內的摺疊也受到分子伴護蛋白協助。錯誤摺疊的蛋白質可能被重新摺疊、隔離，或標記以進行降解。

source: Proteins destined for proteasomal degradation are often tagged with polyubiquitin chains. E3 ubiquitin ligases help determine substrate specificity, and the proteasome unfolds and degrades selected proteins in an ATP-dependent process.
title: Ubiquitin proteasome
zh: 即將由蛋白酶體降解的蛋白質，通常會被多聚泛素鏈標記。泛素連接酶協助決定受質專一性，而蛋白酶體則透過依賴三磷酸腺苷的過程，將選定的蛋白質展開並降解。

source: Cells maintain redox balance through multiple antioxidant systems. Reduced glutathione, thioredoxin, catalase, and superoxide dismutases help control reactive species, while NADPH provides reducing power to regenerate antioxidant capacity.
title: Redox balance
zh: 細胞透過多種抗氧化系統維持氧化還原平衡。還原型穀胱甘肽、硫氧還蛋白、過氧化氫酶與超氧化物歧化酶，有助於控制活性物種；還原型菸鹼醯胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸磷酸則提供還原力，讓抗氧化能力得以再生。

source: DNA damage activates signaling networks that pause the cell cycle and promote repair. If damage cannot be repaired, cells may enter senescence or apoptosis, reducing the risk of propagating severely damaged genomes.
title: DNA damage response
zh: 去氧核糖核酸損傷會啟動訊息傳遞網路，暫停細胞週期並促進修復。如果損傷無法修復，細胞可能進入衰老或凋亡，以降低嚴重受損的基因組繼續傳遞的風險。

source: Gene expression can be regulated after transcription through changes in mRNA stability and translation. MicroRNAs and RNA-binding proteins can alter how long an mRNA persists or how efficiently it is translated.
title: mRNA regulation
zh: 轉錄完成後，基因表現仍可透過信使核糖核酸穩定性與轉譯的變化受到調控。微小核糖核酸及核糖核酸結合蛋白，可以改變信使核糖核酸存留的時間，或其被轉譯的效率。

source: Protein kinases transfer phosphate groups to selected amino acid residues, while phosphatases remove them. Reversible phosphorylation can change enzyme activity, localization, binding interactions, and signal-transduction pathways.
title: Protein phosphorylation
zh: 蛋白激酶會將磷酸基轉移到特定的胺基酸殘基上，而磷酸酶則將它們移除。這種可逆的磷酸化，可以改變酵素活性、蛋白質定位、結合交互作用，以及訊息傳遞路徑。

source: In the intrinsic apoptotic pathway, mitochondrial outer-membrane permeabilization allows cytochrome c to enter the cytosol. This promotes apoptosome formation and activation of initiator and executioner caspases.
title: Apoptotic signaling
zh: 在內源性細胞凋亡路徑中，粒線體外膜通透化會讓細胞色素丙進入細胞質。這會促進凋亡小體形成，並活化啟動型與執行型半胱天冬酶。

source: Autophagy delivers portions of cytoplasm and organelles to lysosomes for degradation. It can support survival during nutrient limitation, but excessive or dysregulated autophagy can also accompany disease states.
title: Autophagy
zh: 自噬將部分細胞質與胞器送往溶小體降解。它可以在營養受限時支持細胞存活，但過度或失調的自噬，也可能伴隨疾病狀態出現。

source: Mitochondria continually undergo fission and fusion. These processes help distribute mitochondria, mix mitochondrial contents, and isolate damaged regions that may later be removed through mitophagy.
title: Mitochondrial dynamics
zh: 粒線體持續進行分裂與融合。這些過程有助於分配粒線體、混合粒線體內容物，以及隔離受損區域；這些受損區域之後可能透過粒線體自噬被移除。

source: PCR amplifies a selected DNA region through repeated cycles of denaturation, primer annealing, and extension. Specificity depends strongly on primer design, annealing conditions, and the quality of the template.
title: PCR amplification
zh: 聚合酶連鎖反應透過反覆進行變性、引子黏合與延伸的循環，擴增特定的去氧核糖核酸區段。其專一性高度取決於引子設計、黏合條件與模板品質。

source: In quantitative PCR, fluorescence is monitored during amplification. A lower threshold cycle generally indicates more starting template, but reliable relative quantification also requires appropriate reference genes and similar amplification efficiencies.
title: qPCR interpretation
zh: 定量聚合酶連鎖反應會在擴增過程中監測螢光。較低的閾值循環數通常表示起始模板較多，但可靠的相對定量也需要適當的參考基因，以及相近的擴增效率。

source: Western blot signals are commonly normalized to a stable loading control or total protein signal. A suitable reference should not change with treatment, because an unstable loading control can create misleading relative expression results.
title: Western blot normalization
zh: 西方墨點法的訊號，通常會以穩定的上樣內參或總蛋白訊號進行正規化。合適的參考指標不應隨處理條件改變，因為不穩定的上樣內參可能造成誤導性的相對表現量結果。

source: Flow cytometry analysis typically begins with a sequence of gates that identify the cell population of interest, exclude debris and doublets, and sometimes remove dead cells. The gating strategy can strongly influence the final quantitative result.
title: Flow cytometry gating
zh: 流式細胞分析通常先依序設定多個圈選範圍，辨識感興趣的細胞族群、排除碎片與雙細胞事件，有時也會去除死細胞。圈選策略可能強烈影響最終的定量結果。

source: Senescent cells remain metabolically active but undergo a durable cell-cycle arrest. They can also develop a senescence-associated secretory phenotype that alters the surrounding tissue environment.
title: Cellular senescence
zh: 衰老細胞仍保有代謝活性，但會進入持久的細胞週期停滯狀態。它們也可能形成衰老相關分泌表型，進而改變周圍組織的環境。

source: Cell-surface receptors can activate enzyme cascades in which one activated molecule modifies many downstream targets. This signal amplification allows a small extracellular stimulus to produce a large intracellular response.
title: Signal amplification
zh: 細胞表面受體可以啟動酵素級聯反應，其中一個被活化的分子能修飾許多下游標的。這種訊號放大作用，讓微弱的細胞外刺激也能引發強烈的細胞內反應。

source: Cells can shift their use of glucose, fatty acids, and amino acids depending on nutrient availability and functional state. This metabolic flexibility is important for adapting to stress and maintaining ATP production.
title: Metabolic flexibility
zh: 細胞可以依據營養供應情況與功能狀態，調整對葡萄糖、脂肪酸及胺基酸的利用。這種代謝彈性對適應壓力與維持三磷酸腺苷生成相當重要。

source: Reactive oxygen species can damage cellular components when present at high levels, but low or transient ROS can also function as signaling molecules. Therefore, the biological effect depends on species, location, concentration, and duration.
title: ROS signaling
zh: 活性氧在高濃度時會損傷細胞組成，但低濃度或短暫出現的活性氧也能作為訊號分子。因此，其生物作用取決於活性氧的種類、位置、濃度與持續時間。
